    X_ctrl = df[control_cols].values
    X_ctrl = np.column_stack([X_ctrl, np.ones(len(X_ctrl))])
    
    y_arr = df[y_col].values
    x_arr = df[x_col].values
    
    # Residualize y on controls
    b_y, _, _, _ = lstsq(X_ctrl, y_arr, rcond=None)
